title: Oyatie North-Star Completion Programme — Requirements Specification
restated_goal: Complete the Oyatie-only programme as a frozen six-track AND-join — disposition-led reorg and debrand into a registry-ratified capability layout with a gate-enforced edge contract, temporal recovery through an enumerator-pinned census with a fail-closed value-tested hot set, an owned-Rust substrate closing on a ratified per-layer ownership ladder across three structurally-independent operating modes, a survivorship-ratified Product-100 portfolio under the Foundry taxonomy, and an owned delivery fabric with owned CAS as live merge authority at exit — all closed against founder-ratified, corridor-derived numeric envelopes, sealed by independently verified, hash-pinned completion receipts, with no tracker drift and no authority vacuum at any point.

authority_model.work_item_authority: specs/masterplan.json#masterplan_v2 is sole authority; ultragoal ledger, beads, and GitHub issues are canonical-id projections carrying identical id, status, and successor mapping; scheduled reconciliation gate; divergence is a blocking authority defect freezing dispatch for affected items until audited repair.
authority_model.accountable_owner: The founder is the named incumbent for all programme-freeze ratifications, dual-mandate decisions, and auditable amendments; succession only via auditable amendment naming a specific successor; no committee authority.
authority_model.adjudication: Invariant floor + accountable business judgment: hard public-interest and company-interest floors, then evidence-recorded founder judgment above them.
authority_model.hold_release: HOLD(Planning) lifts on explicit approval of this crystallized spec plus the ralplan consensus plan; encoding masterplan_v2 (six tracks, three-mode bar, Foundry taxonomy, Kernel/OS items) is the first execution wave through a valid authority transition; current Accepted ADRs and oya-ci-required remain binding until replaced; no authority vacuum ever.
authority_model.completion_seal: Each ComponentExit packet verified by an independent reviewer lane that did not implement it; reconciliation gate confirms zero drift and no open amendments; founder signs; receipt pins six exit-evidence hashes, ratified envelope hashes, and census/inventory/catalog snapshot hashes; evidence invalidation reopens the exit via amendment.

completion_model.finish_line: Frozen six-track AND-join; no subset closes the programme; production-100 continues after completion but terminal exits evaluate against ratified snapshots (BarRatchet cannot move the receipt).
completion_model.operating_modes: Shared, dedicated, and customer-operated federated/decentralized are all exit-bearing for substrate and delivery; product mode coverage is per-product via the mode-applicability matrix with dual-mandate-ratified exclusions.
completion_model.numeric_freeze: Substrate SLO/DR/cost/compliance/region/FrozenCapabilitySet, delivery/CAS hit-rate/latency/reliability/cost/rollback/failure-injection/window, and Product-100 floor+overlay values all freeze at programme ratification.
completion_model.corridor_rule: Every ratified numeric requires documented provenance: measured live-tree/workload baseline plus explicit margin, benchmarked against public hyperscaler parity classes; founder ratifies inside the corridor; unprovenanced numbers are unratifiable; baseline measurement is a ratification prerequisite.

tracks.exit: Reconciled authority: masterplan_v2 encodes the six-track programme with dependency edges, owners, acceptance criteria, failure modes, and evidence classes; canonical-id projection contract live; drift-free reconciliation gate operating; completion receipt contract in force.

Closed census (automated enumerator over Git refs/worktrees/stashes/GitHub PRs+issues, freeze-pinned snapshot hash, no manual edits, amendment-only post-freeze entries) with every identity in exactly one evidence-bound terminal state (landed / absorbed-superseded / preserved-and-parked with restart evidence / safely-retired); hot set admitted only via ratified three-arm value test (advances ratified work item, unique unrecovered content, blocking-defect fix), fail-closed to parked; landing fail-closes on unbounded restack or full-estate rebuild, bounded by push budget with parked-rail overflow; trackers synchronized.

Every legacy target dispositioned (refactor/rewrite/remove/reconsider/replan/justified relocation — never simple git mv); destination-root inventory survey-proposed and founder-ratified (one registered capability per root, core/ports/adapters/facade faces, products under app/<product>/); inter-root edges only via published port/facade contracts, registry-recorded, cycle-free, enforced by blocking structure gate; zero residual debrand identifiers (oya-, oya_, cloud-, cloud_, workflow_, workflow-, Workflow Studio, Workflow Engine) against the founder-ratified carve-out catalog with per-entry third-party/generic-English origin proof; uncataloged hits, unregistered/duplicate/dual-home roots block closure; whole-tree architecture and behavior proof at each destination root.

Frozen Production-100 across kuberos kernel, node/OS, Kubernetes Rust port, cloud capabilities, fleet/control plane, each closing on its ratified per-layer deliverable plus ownership degree (owned-authored / owned mechanical port tracking upstream / transient dependency behind a port with deletion criteria); live evidence in all three modes; customer cells require structural operator independence (distinct legal entity, no Oyatie production-credential access, non-Oyatie-controlled infrastructure) meeting the ratified minimum cell count; air-gapped evidence via signed attestation packets (frozen-envelope measurements, cell identity, version hashes, operator signature) verified against ratified keys, fail-closed; baselines measured on live trees (currently cloud/cloud-kernel, os/) until valid unblocked cutover.

Surviving portfolio survey-proposed and founder-ratified at freeze; every surviving product passes the common Production-100 floor plus each declared mode's overlay; exclusions via dual-mandate evidence; Foundry ratified as multi-discipline umbrella with Workflow Studio→Foundry Studio and Workflow Engine→Foundry Engine; Intelligence remains separate; membership changes post-freeze only via auditable amendment.

Owned delivery fabric — in post-reorg destination capability identity, never cloud-*/oya-* names — is live merge and delivery authority across all three modes; GitHub retired to evidence-preserving bridge/mirror via evidence-gated cutover (parallel-run proof against ratified envelope, rollback path, no authority vacuum); owned Rust CAS control/data path at exit with hosted CAS only as bounded transition bridge; sustained Production-100 outcome envelope over real workloads meets frozen hit-rate/latency/reliability/cost/rollback/failure-injection thresholds over the ratified window; cold-cache fallback proven; merge authority independent of CAS.

constraints: Oyatie repository/programme only; Console plans excluded.
Deep-interview and ralplan are requirements/planning only; no product mutation or execution before explicit approval.
Reorganization is disposition-led; simple git mv is prohibited.
No new code, capabilities, or exit dependencies under reorg-target paths (cloud-*, cloud_, oya-*, oya_, oya/**, cloud/**); new work lands in destination shape only.
Debrand is part of reorg, not later cleanup; false-positive carve-outs require ratified origin proof.
CI integrity: preserve the full protected admission bar, surface all failures, no mass-restack or CI amplification.
Preservation-first: classify and preserve all valuable work before cleanup or ref mutation.
oya-ci-required is itself debrand-scope with a required owned successor before destination close; it remains binding until that successor exists.
Fail-closed defaults everywhere: unverifiable attestation, unprovenanced numbers, uncataloged scanner hits, unclassified census items, out-of-hot-set landings, and tracker drift all block.

execution_wave_prerequisites.note: These artifact-bound items are the documented residual ambiguity (42.0%); each is an execution-wave output with its governing contract already locked.
disposition_survey: carve-out catalog contents (seeded by the Round 25 audit)
census_run: full worktree/branch/stash cleanliness evidence over the 416-worktree, 1,446-branch estate
baseline_measurement: substrate SLO/DR/cost baselines on live trees
delivery/CAS hit-rate, latency, build-cost, CI-reliability baselines
product workload baselines for floor/overlay corridors
programme_freeze_ratification: all numeric envelope values via the corridor rule
hot-set membership, push budget, parked-rail capacity
cutover parallel-run window, bridge/mirror retention, per-mode sequencing

handoff_chain: crystallized spec → ralplan consensus → explicit user approval (or valid non-off ralplan final runtime admission) → separately authorized ultragoal execution; first execution wave encodes masterplan_v2.
